Card Q&A.a: Yes. Even if you revealed only a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, you still add that card to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: I reveal 5 cards with this card's [On Play] effect. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits and 1 Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers digivolves, gain 2 memory.
